sources.title: Error-bounded probabilistic computations between MA and AM
sources.version: University of Würzburg technical report299; cover and dated title page inspected; final JCSS72(6),1043–1076(2006) not retrieved in this pass
sources.review_depth: Relevant full-text taxonomy and definitions, plus visual Figure1; oracle scope checked. Not every proof reconstructed.
sources.finding: Few→SPP→WPP→AWPP→APP→PP supplies no missing roster edge. WAPP is a different #P class below AWPP; it cannot replace WPP. Section5 noninclusions use oracles.

sources.title: The Robustness of LWPP and WPP, with an Application to Graph Reconstruction
sources.review_depth: Definitions and relevant theorem statements/proof constructions, not full oracle diagonalizations.
sources.finding: Polynomial target lists preserve LWPP,WPP and CeqP. Exp-LWPP=coCeqP counts exponentially many possible target values, not extra time, and is not LWPP. LWPP+ uses #P and is distinct. No new roster edge.

sources.title: Gaps, Ambiguity, and Establishing Complexity-Class Containments via Iterative Constant-Setting
sources.review_depth: Restriction definitions, taxonomy and principal metatheorem scope; not every application proof.
sources.finding: Restricted counting RC_S requires zero accepting paths on no-inputs, unlike SPP zero gap. Existing FewP-to-parity/SPP consequences are already encoded. Bounds on ambiguity and target density do not establish FewP⊆UP or SPP⊆FewP.

sources.title: An Oracle Builder's Toolkit
sources.review_depth: Rechecked definitions and taxonomy; later AWPP passages already directly read in round2.
sources.finding: Confirms UP→FewP→Few→SPP→LWPP→WPP→CeqP∩coCeqP→PP and WPP→AWPP. Intersections and complement notation are retained.

sources.title: Gap-definable Counting Classes
locators: Corollary6.2 and Proposition6.3,printed p.20,visually inspected this round
sources.new_evidence: limited new scope check; core exact-count results already read
sources.review_depth: Previously reviewed core passages plus fresh visual reading of p.20; raw text extraction is corrupted.
sources.finding: Almost(C) and random-oracle lowness retain their oracle/probability qualifier; they are not ordinary PH⊆SPP or an extra internal edge.

sources.title: Quantum and Classical Complexity Classes: Separations, Collapses, and Closure Properties
locators: Previously reviewed closure and collapse passages in round2
sources.review_depth: Inherited explicit prior primary checks and cross-review, not newly recovered full text.
sources.finding: WPP truth-table closure and oracle failures of stronger closure do not give ordinary WPP≠LWPP. No new fact proposed from this source.

sources.title: Counting Complexity
sources.review_depth: Author survey taxonomy, low-class identities and oracle statements.
sources.finding: Gap-zero, positive-gap and parity tests remain distinct. Oracle parity-versus-PP separations do not classify ordinary pairs; SPP lowness alone does not eliminate arbitrary oracle levels.

risk_assessment.event: At least one accepted older ordinary inclusion still missing somewhere among the53 internal candidates, after earlier application/model causes are assigned. Conditional impact is the union of distinct wrong labels from all such omissions.
risk_assessment.reason_for_change: A concrete previously inaccessible primary taxonomy was recovered, and the LWPP/WPP robustness and ambiguity/restricted-counting follow-up branches were checked directly. They close identifiable retrieval/terminology gaps. A modest quarter reduction in the family-event probability reflects that evidence; correlated citations and nonexhaustive coverage prevent a stronger update. No new label was found.
risk_assessment.why_impact_retained: Local hypothetical inclusions often affect1–4 internal pairs, but a missed stronger collapse can affect many. Keeping mean5 retains allowance for correlated union impact rather than equating impact with one pair or one theorem.
risk_assessment.aggregation: Replace0.20 with0.15; do not add0.15 to the prior row. Other components unchanged. This dossier alone does not establish a global stopping condition.
would_raise_estimate: An accepted ordinary pair found through an uncensused intermediate class or terminology.
A relevant addition in the unretrieved2006 final BGM text absent from its2002 report.
An independent taxonomy conflicting with the ten-edge projection.
would_lower_estimate: Independent expert review of the53 candidates and the actual final journal reference chains.
Recovery and review of the2006 final version, plus genuinely new primary branches rather than repeated citations.
risk_assessment.excluded: Future-discovered flaws in currently accepted proofs, as requested; present translation/application errors are charged elsewhere.
